verdict.rationale: Scheduling is normally outside a GPU accelerator's scope. However, AMD's own Instinct documentation lists Spur, described as an "AI-native job scheduler, drop-in compatible with Slurm, with GPU-first scheduling," so the axis applies through the first-party ecosystem. The evidence is a single one-line catalog entry: it supports job scheduling but says nothing about recurring or time-based schedules, or about workflow orchestration. Missing for 10: documented recurring/cron-style job scheduling, workflow/DAG chaining, in-depth Spur documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
